source.note: Five-year UK rights deal with Sky Sports and the BBC, worth about £65m. Broadcast rights, not a shirt partnership; recorded here as a league partner because Sky is also a WSL principal partner. Replaces dead link sportspro.com/news/sky-sports-bbc-womens-super-league-tv-deal/ (404); this article covers the same deal (2025/26-2029/30, ~£65m).

note: Broadcast rights, not sponsorship — the site should show it as a league partner.
